summary.goal: Allow users to create a plan by importing a PRD, spec, or other document
summary.context: Users with detailed specs can paste or upload documents. AI extracts structure, identifies steps and scopes, and produces a draft plan for review.

acceptance_criteria.description: Text area accepts pasted document content
AI extracts steps from document structure
AI identifies scopes from document context
Preview shows extracted structure before creating
User can adjust extraction before creating plan
Source document linked in plan metadata

steps.title: Add import tab to NewPlanPage
steps.description: Add tab navigation between 'From Goal' and 'From Document' modes on plan creation page.

acceptance_criteria.description: Import tab shows document input options

steps.title: Create document paste textarea
steps.description: Large textarea for pasting document content with character counter.

steps.title: Implement file upload
steps.description: Add file upload with drag-drop support. Accept .md, .txt, read content into textarea.

steps.title: Create extraction preview component
steps.description: Show preview of extracted structure before creating plan. List of detected scopes and steps.

steps.title: Connect to API for document processing
steps.description: Call API to process document and create plan with extracted structure.

steps.title: Add document reference to plan
steps.description: Store reference to source document in plan metadata for traceability.

acceptance_criteria.description: Source filename stored in plan metadata
Source reference visible in plan view
Link to original content if available
